title: Fix HQ's broken-reference checker running before work items load
tier_reason: The dashboard's own consistency check is currently wrong for every pillar, which defeats its purpose of surfacing real broken references.
ask: Accepted “Restore publishing to a live storefront”. The dashboard's own consistency check is currently wrong for every pillar, which defeats its purpose of surfacing real broken references.
first_action: In hq/server.py's main(), call work.bind(sys.modules[__name__]) before check_consistency() (currently check_consistency() runs first, so work.items() sees an unbound WORK path and returns empty, making every goal's work-item route falsely report as missing).
source_message: Accepted “Restore publishing to a live storefront”. The dashboard's own consistency check is currently wrong for every pillar, which defeats its purpose of surfacing real broken references.
